annotations.title: Ask humans what they see in an image

description: Real people describe what they see in an image or pick one of your labels. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

image_url.description: https URL of the image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 1.2 MB).

question.description: What humans should answer, e.g. 'What is happening in this picture?'
